:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.8`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noDrizzleDbObjectInsideTransaction`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`drizzle`](/linter/domains#drizzle)
## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noDrizzleDbObjectInsideTransaction": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow using a Drizzle ORM instance inside its own transaction callback.

Inside `db.transaction(async (tx) => { ... })`, queries must use the transaction object `tx`.
Queries made with `db` run outside the transaction: they aren't rolled back when the
transaction fails, they don't see its uncommitted changes, and they can wait forever for
rows that the transaction has locked.

## Options

Use the `drizzleObjectName` option to specify the variable names that represent Drizzle
ORM instances. This option has no default value, and the rule reports nothing until it's set.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noDrizzleDbObjectInsideTransaction": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"drizzleObjectName": [
							"db"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await db.insert(users).values({ name: "John" });
});
```

### Valid

```js
await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.insert(users).values({ name: "John" });
});
```
